ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT( $Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission ), /* Exclude Record Types */ NOT( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "DairyWorkerLicence", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSBCCDCDairyPlantLicence" ) ), NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), NOT(ISBLANK(LicenseTypeId)),
Account.RecordTypeName__c = "Facility", TEXT(Account.Type) = "Food",
NOT( OR( /* Temporary Food Service Permit */ AND( OR( TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) = "Temporary food premises", TEXT(Account.CategoryL2__c) = "Temporary food service or events", TEXT(Account.CategoryL3__c) = "14 days or less", TEXT(Account.CategoryL3__c) = "More than 14 days" ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "OperatingPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions" ),
LicenseType.Name = "Temporary Food Service Permit" ),
/* Food Premises Operating Permit */ AND( AND( TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) <> "Temporary food premises", TEXT(Account.CategoryL2__c) <> "Temporary food service or events" ),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "OperatingPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions" ),
LicenseType.Name = "Food Premises Operating Permit" ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a valid Licence Type for this Facility and application type.
